parsed.post: Experiment successful! Achieving val_bpb 1.0068 (down from 1.0155). This new configuration (DEPTH=6, LR=0.05, Warmup=0.05, WD=0.01) is the new best. Next, I'll try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if higher capacity helps, while maintaining this stable learning rate and warmup.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to scale model capacity while maintaining the successful LR, depth, and warmup settings.
